content.text:
All three renders are clean. Done.

**Files written** (in the working folder):
- `square.png` — 1080×1080
- `landscape.png` — 1920×1080
- `story.png` — 1080×1920
- `card.html` — the source template (`?size=square|landscape|story`)

**Design**
- Deep `#0F1226` canvas with two soft violet radial glows (top-left / bottom-right), white text, `#7C5CFF` accent.
- Inter loaded via `@font-face` from the local `Inter.ttf` (variable weights 100–900); rendering waits on `document.fonts.ready` so nothing is measured in a fallback face.
- Logo + a hairline rule + letterspaced "FIELDNOTES CONF 2026" in the header.
- Portrait is a true circle (`border-radius:50%` on a square box) with a violet ring + halo, background-cropped to 154% at 50%/25% so the face is centred rather than the empty wall.
- Talk title is two-tone (white lead-in, violet payoff) and wraps across 4–5 lines.

**Per-size layout**
- *Square*: header → portrait + name/role row → title → footer (date/venue left, pill right).
- *Landscape*: header spanning the top, then a two-column body — portrait with name/role stacked beneath on the left, title on the right — and the footer across the bottom. The DOM is reflowed by script so square/story get a single centred column instead.
- *Story*: fully centred vertical stack with a larger 380px portrait.

**Fit guarantees** — a script binary-searches the title size on a 0.5px grid, capped per size (92 / 112 / 90px), then re-verifies and steps down until `scrollHeight`/`scrollWidth` genuinely fit the box. That caught a real bug: the first pass rounded the chosen size *up* to 2 decimals, which tipped the square title onto a 5th line and pushed it 18px outside its box. I also fixed a collapsed landscape title column (`align-items:center` was shrink-wrapping the right column to 20px, starving the fitter) and the underline the browser put on the `<a class="btn">`.

Final automated audit on all three: no element crosses the canvas edge, no overlap between header/portrait/title/footer blocks, titles clear their boxes by 60/223/208px, avatars measure exactly square with 50% radius, and the saved PNGs are exactly 1080×1080, 1920×1080 and 1080×1920.
